rules.logic: ABIOC(NDR-011 Telegram Bot API C2 Egress Deviating from Host SaaS Baseline) AND ABIOC(NDR-011 avp.exe Masquerade Spawning Command Shell Stitched to Telegram C2) — fuses the network Bot-API C2 egress deviation and the avp.exe->cmd.exe masquerade dispatch on the same agent_hostname/src_ip into a single LampoRAT Telegram-C2 incident anchored to the SaaS-egress-plus-masquerade causality chain, surviving the SaaS allowlist that defeats reputation and IOC matching.
rules.name: LampoRAT Telegram-Bot-API C2 on Allowlisted SaaS — ABIOC Causality Stitch
